reason: I just cancelled a $20 planner, and half the reason I time-block is checking the plan between meetings and on the go. Without a phone app this would only cover part of my day, and there are no reviews or Reddit threads yet to tell me it beats what I already tried.
objection: No phone app means I can't check or reflow my plan once I'm away from my desk, and I can't find any independent reviews or comparisons with Sunsama or Motion.
would_change_my_mind: A real mobile app plus a few honest Reddit or YouTube comparisons against Sunsama showing the end-of-block check-in actually sticks.
